description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Heartmender
When Heartmender dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Heartmender enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Heartmender
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
